### 6.5.7 Forest Plot: RDC vs SDC at 48H

```{r ancombc2-48h-rdc-sdc-forest-plot, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
# Prepare data for 48H RDC vs SDC forest plot
if (nrow(ancombc2_48h_rdc_sdc_tbl) > 0 && "q_value" %in% names(ancombc2_48h_rdc_sdc_tbl)) {
  # Focus on carbohydrateSDC effect (SDC vs RDC, with RDC as reference)
  forest_48h_rdc_sdc_data <- ancombc2_48h_rdc_sdc_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(effect == "carbohydrateSDC") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      ci_lower = beta - 1.96 * se,
      ci_upper = beta + 1.96 * se,
      taxon_label = stringr::str_replace(taxon, "^g__", ""),
      significance = dplyr::case_when(
        q_value < 0.001 ~ "q < 0.001",
        q_value < 0.01 ~ "q < 0.01",
        q_value < 0.05 ~ "q < 0.05",
        q_value < 0.1 ~ "q < 0.1",
        TRUE ~ "q ≥ 0.1"
      ),
      # Positive beta means higher in SDC, negative means higher in RDC
      direction = dplyr::if_else(beta > 0, "Higher in SDC", "Higher in RDC")
    ) %>%
    # Order by absolute effect size, but show significant ones first
    dplyr::arrange(q_value, desc(abs(beta)))
  
  # Select top taxa for display (either significant or top by effect size)
  if (sum(forest_48h_rdc_sdc_data$q_value < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
    forest_48h_rdc_sdc_plot_data <- forest_48h_rdc_sdc_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(q_value < 0.1) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(beta))) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 25)
  } else {
    # If no significant, show top 25 by effect size
    forest_48h_rdc_sdc_plot_data <- forest_48h_rdc_sdc_data %>%
      dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(beta))) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 25)
  }
  
  if (nrow(forest_48h_rdc_sdc_plot_data) > 0) {
    # Reorder for plotting (by beta value)
    forest_48h_rdc_sdc_plot_data <- forest_48h_rdc_sdc_plot_data %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        taxon_label = factor(taxon_label, levels = rev(unique(taxon_label[order(beta)])))
      )
    
    ancombc2_48h_rdc_sdc_forest_plot <- ggplot(
      forest_48h_rdc_sdc_plot_data,
      aes(x = beta, y = taxon_label, color = significance)
    ) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
      geom_point(size = 2.5, aes(shape = direction)) +
      geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_lower, xmax = ci_upper), 
                     height = 0.2, alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 1) +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c("q < 0.001" = "#d73027", 
                   "q < 0.01" = "#f46d43",
                   "q < 0.05" = "#fdae61", 
                   "q < 0.1" = "#fee08b",
                   "q ≥ 0.1" = "gray70"),
        name = "FDR-adjusted\np-value",
        guide = guide_legend(order = 1)
      ) +
      scale_shape_manual(
        values = c("Higher in SDC" = 17, "Higher in RDC" = 19),
        name = "Direction",
        guide = guide_legend(order = 2)
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "ANCOM-BC2: RDC vs SDC at 48H",
        subtitle = "Effect sizes (log-fold change: SDC vs RDC) with 95% confidence intervals",
        x = "Log-fold change (SDC vs RDC)",
        y = "Genus",
        caption = "Positive values indicate higher abundance in SDC; negative values indicate higher abundance in RDC"
      ) +
      theme_scfa() +
      theme(
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.box = "horizontal",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      )
    
    print(ancombc2_48h_rdc_sdc_forest_plot)
    
    # Summary statistics
    cat("\nSummary of ANCOM-BC2 RDC vs SDC at 48H:\n")
    cat("Total taxa tested:", nrow(forest_48h_rdc_sdc_data), "\n")
    cat("Significant taxa (q < 0.1):", sum(forest_48h_rdc_sdc_data$q_value < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
    cat("Higher in SDC (q < 0.1):", sum(forest_48h_rdc_sdc_data$beta > 0 & forest_48h_rdc_sdc_data$q_value < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
    cat("Higher in RDC (q < 0.1):", sum(forest_48h_rdc_sdc_data$beta < 0 & forest_48h_rdc_sdc_data$q_value < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  } else {
    cat("No data available for 48H RDC vs SDC forest plot\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No ANCOM-BC2 48H RDC vs SDC results available for forest plot\n")
}
```



### 6.5.8 MaAsLin2 Analysis

MaAsLin2 (Microbiome Multivariable Associations with Linear Models) uses generalized linear models to identify associations between microbial taxa and metadata variables while accounting for confounding factors. We applied MaAsLin2 to identify taxa associated with group, carbohydrate type, and timepoint.

```{r maaslin2-analysis, echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE, cache.path="cache/integrated-"}
# Prepare data for MaAsLin2 (needs count data)
ps_maaslin2 <- ps_genus

# Prepare count matrix and metadata
# Use proper conversion methods for phyloseq objects
maaslin2_counts <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_maaslin2))
maaslin2_meta <- as(sample_data(ps_maaslin2), "data.frame")
maaslin2_meta$SampleID <- rownames(maaslin2_meta)

# Ensure numeric columns are numeric
maaslin2_meta <- maaslin2_meta %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    subject_id = as.character(subject_id),
    group = as.factor(group),
    carbohydrate = as.factor(carbohydrate),
    timepoint = as.factor(timepoint)
  )

# Run MaAsLin2 (suppress output)
maaslin2_fit <- tryCatch({
  suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
    capture.output(
      maaslin2_fit_result <- Maaslin2::Maaslin2(
        input_data = maaslin2_counts,
        input_metadata = maaslin2_meta,
        output = tempfile(pattern = "maaslin2_", tmpdir = getwd()),  # Create temporary output directory
        min_prevalence = 0.05,
        normalization = "TSS",
        transform = "LOG",
        analysis_method = "LM",
        fixed_effects = c("group", "carbohydrate", "timepoint"),
        random_effects = c("subject_id"),
        plot_heatmap = FALSE,
        plot_scatter = FALSE
      ),
      file = nullfile()
    )
  ))
  maaslin2_fit_result
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("MaAsLin2 failed:", e$message, "\n")
  NULL
})

# Extract results
if (!is.null(maaslin2_fit) && !is.null(maaslin2_fit$results)) {
  maaslin2_tbl <- maaslin2_fit$results %>%
    dplyr::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      q = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH")  # Add BH-adjusted q-value
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(q)
  
  # Add taxonomy information
  tax_table_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_maaslin2)) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("feature") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Genus_clean = stringr::str_replace(Genus, "^g__", ""),
      Species_clean = stringr::str_replace(Species, "^s__", ""),
      Family_clean = stringr::str_replace(Family, "^f__", ""),
      # Only use Species if Genus is valid; if Genus is NA, use Family
      genus_species = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(Genus_clean) & Genus_clean != "NA" & Genus_clean != "" &
          !is.na(Species_clean) & Species_clean != "NA" & Species_clean != "" ~ 
          paste0(Genus_clean, " ", Species_clean),
        !is.na(Genus_clean) & Genus_clean != "NA" & Genus_clean != "" ~ Genus_clean,
        !is.na(Family_clean) & Family_clean != "NA" & Family_clean != "" ~ Family_clean,
        TRUE ~ feature
      )
    )
  
  maaslin2_tbl <- maaslin2_tbl %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      tax_table_df %>% dplyr::select(feature, Genus, genus_species),
      by = "feature"
    )
  
  # Summary of significant results
  maaslin2_sig <- maaslin2_tbl %>% dplyr::filter(q < 0.1)
  cat("MaAsLin2 significant results (q < 0.1):", nrow(maaslin2_sig), "feature-metadata combinations\n")
} else {
  maaslin2_tbl <- tibble(
    feature = character(0),
    metadata = character(0),
    value = character(0),
    coef = numeric(0),
    stderr = numeric(0),
    pval = numeric(0),
    qval = numeric(0),
    q = numeric(0),
    Genus = character(0),
    genus_species = character(0)
  )
  cat("No MaAsLin2 results available\n")
}
```

### 6.5.9 MaAsLin2 Summary Table

```{r maaslin2-summary-table, echo=FALSE}
# Create summary table with taxon, genus_species, method, p-value, q-value
# Fill NA values from taxonomy table and ensure taxon is always seq##
if (nrow(maaslin2_tbl) > 0) {
  # Get full taxonomy table for lookups - use original ps object before genus aggregation
  # to get ASV-level taxonomy
  tax_table_full <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps)) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("feature") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      # Clean taxonomy levels - remove prefixes and check for valid values
      Genus_clean = stringr::str_replace(Genus, "^g__", ""),
      Species_clean = stringr::str_replace(Species, "^s__", ""),
      Family_clean = stringr::str_replace(Family, "^f__", ""),
      Order_clean = stringr::str_replace(Order, "^o__", ""),
      Class_clean = stringr::str_replace(Class, "^c__", ""),
      Phylum_clean = stringr::str_replace(Phylum, "^p__", ""),
      Kingdom_clean = stringr::str_replace(Kingdom, "^k__", ""),
      # Get first non-NA taxonomy level (skip "NA" strings)
      # IMPORTANT: Only use Species if Genus is valid; if Genus is NA, use Family
      first_non_na_tax = dplyr::case_when(
        # Use Genus + Species only if both are valid
        !is.na(Genus_clean) & Genus_clean != "NA" & Genus_clean != "" &
          !is.na(Species_clean) & Species_clean != "NA" & Species_clean != "" ~ 
          paste0(Genus_clean, " ", Species_clean),
        # Use Genus alone if valid
        !is.na(Genus_clean) & Genus_clean != "NA" & Genus_clean != "" ~ Genus_clean,
        # If Genus is NA, use Family
        !is.na(Family_clean) & Family_clean != "NA" & Family_clean != "" ~ Family_clean,
        # Continue down the hierarchy
        !is.na(Order_clean) & Order_clean != "NA" & Order_clean != "" ~ Order_clean,
        !is.na(Class_clean) & Class_clean != "NA" & Class_clean != "" ~ Class_clean,
        !is.na(Phylum_clean) & Phylum_clean != "NA" & Phylum_clean != "" ~ Phylum_clean,
        !is.na(Kingdom_clean) & Kingdom_clean != "NA" & Kingdom_clean != "" ~ Kingdom_clean,
        TRUE ~ feature
      )
    )
  
  maaslin2_summary_tbl <- maaslin2_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(q < 0.1) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      tax_table_full %>% dplyr::select(feature, first_non_na_tax),
      by = "feature"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      # Fill NA genus_species with first non-NA taxonomy level (always use taxonomy, never feature)
      `Genus Species` = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(genus_species) & genus_species != "NA" & genus_species != "" & !stringr::str_starts(genus_species, "seq") ~ 
          stringr::str_replace_all(genus_species, "^(g__|f__|o__|c__|p__|k__)", ""),
        !is.na(first_non_na_tax) & first_non_na_tax != "NA" & first_non_na_tax != "" & !stringr::str_starts(first_non_na_tax, "seq") ~
          stringr::str_replace_all(first_non_na_tax, "^(g__|f__|o__|c__|p__|k__)", ""),
        TRUE ~ stringr::str_replace_all(first_non_na_tax, "^(g__|f__|o__|c__|p__|k__)", "")
      ),
      `DA Method` = "MaAsLin2",
      `p value` = signif(pval, 4),
      `q value` = signif(q, 4),
      `Effect Size (coef)` = signif(coef, 4),
      Variable = paste0(metadata, "=", value)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(taxon = feature, `Genus Species`, 
                  `DA Method`, Variable, `Effect Size (coef)`, `p value`, `q value`)
  
  # Combine with ANCOM-BC2 results if available
  if (nrow(ancombc2_tbl) > 0 && "q_value" %in% names(ancombc2_tbl)) {
    # Map ANCOM-BC2 genus-level taxa back to ASV IDs (seq##)
    # Get ASV to genus mapping from original ps object
    asv_to_genus_map <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps)) %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("asv_id") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        genus_match = stringr::str_replace(Genus, "^g__", "")
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(asv_id, Genus, genus_match)
    
    # Create a mapping: for each unique genus in ANCOM-BC2, find first ASV with that genus
    genus_to_asv_mapping <- asv_to_genus_map %>%
      dplyr::group_by(genus_match) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup() %>%
      dplyr::select(genus_match, asv_id)
    
    # Get full taxonomy for all ASVs (for lookup later)
    # Use the same tax_table_full that already has first_non_na_tax calculated correctly
    ancombc2_tax_lookup_full <- tax_table_full %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        genus_match = stringr::str_replace(Genus, "^g__", "")
      )
    
    ancombc2_summary_tbl <- ancombc2_tbl %>%
      dplyr::filter(q_value < 0.1) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        genus_clean = stringr::str_replace(taxon, "^g__", "")
      ) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        genus_to_asv_mapping,
        by = c("genus_clean" = "genus_match")
      ) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        ancombc2_tax_lookup_full %>% dplyr::select(feature, first_non_na_tax),
        by = c("asv_id" = "feature")
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        # Use mapped ASV ID as taxon (seq##), use first non-NA taxonomy for Genus Species
        taxon = dplyr::case_when(
          !is.na(asv_id) ~ asv_id,
          TRUE ~ taxon  # Fallback to original taxon if no match
        ),
        # Ensure Genus Species uses taxonomy, not seq## or NA
        `Genus Species` = dplyr::case_when(
          !is.na(first_non_na_tax) & first_non_na_tax != "NA" & first_non_na_tax != "" & 
            !stringr::str_starts(first_non_na_tax, "seq") ~
            stringr::str_replace_all(first_non_na_tax, "^(g__|f__|o__|c__|p__|k__)", ""),
          !is.na(genus_clean) & genus_clean != "NA" & genus_clean != "" ~ 
            stringr::str_replace_all(genus_clean, "^(g__|f__|o__|c__|p__|k__)", ""),
          TRUE ~ taxon
        ),
        `DA Method` = "ANCOM-BC2",
        `p value` = signif(p_value, 4),
        `q value` = signif(q_value, 4),
        `Effect Size (coef)` = signif(beta, 4),
        Variable = effect
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(taxon, `Genus Species`, `DA Method`, Variable, 
                    `Effect Size (coef)`, `p value`, `q value`)
    
    # Combine both methods
    da_summary_combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(maaslin2_summary_tbl, ancombc2_summary_tbl)
  } else {
    da_summary_combined <- maaslin2_summary_tbl
  }
  
  # Final cleanup: ensure no NA or seq## in Genus Species, remove all prefixes
  # Create lookup table for any remaining missing values
  tax_lookup_final <- tax_table_full %>%
    dplyr::select(feature, first_non_na_tax_final = first_non_na_tax)
  
  da_summary_combined <- da_summary_combined %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      tax_lookup_final,
      by = c("taxon" = "feature")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      # Remove all prefixes from Genus Species
      `Genus Species` = stringr::str_replace_all(`Genus Species`, "^(g__|f__|o__|c__|p__|k__)", ""),
      # If Genus Species is still NA, seq##, or empty, use lookup
      `Genus Species` = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(`Genus Species`) | `Genus Species` == "NA" | `Genus Species` == "" | stringr::str_starts(`Genus Species`, "seq") ~
          stringr::str_replace_all(first_non_na_tax_final, "^(g__|f__|o__|c__|p__|k__)", ""),
        TRUE ~ `Genus Species`
      ),
      # Final check: ensure no seq## or NA remains
      `Genus Species` = dplyr::case_when(
        stringr::str_starts(`Genus Species`, "seq") | `Genus Species` == "NA" | is.na(`Genus Species`) ~
          stringr::str_replace_all(first_non_na_tax_final, "^(g__|f__|o__|c__|p__|k__)", ""),
        TRUE ~ `Genus Species`
      ),
      # Remove any remaining prefixes one more time
      `Genus Species` = stringr::str_replace_all(`Genus Species`, "^(g__|f__|o__|c__|p__|k__)", "")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-first_non_na_tax_final) %>%
    # Sort alphabetically by Genus Species
    dplyr::arrange(`Genus Species`, `q value`)
  
  # Display as interactive table in HTML or kable otherwise
  if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
    DT::datatable(
      da_summary_combined,
      caption = "Summary of Differential Abundance Results (q < 0.1)",
      filter = "top",
      options = list(pageLength = 25, scrollX = TRUE, order = list(list(1, 'asc')))
    )
  } else {
    knitr::kable(da_summary_combined, caption = "Summary of Differential Abundance Results (q < 0.1)")
  }
} else {
  cat("No differential abundance results available for summary table\n")
}
```

### 6.5.10 MaAsLin2 Visualizations

```{r maaslin2-visualizations, echo=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=16}
if (nrow(maaslin2_tbl) > 0 && nrow(maaslin2_tbl %>% dplyr::filter(q < 0.1)) > 0) {
  # Get taxonomy table for Family lookups (for NA taxa)
  tax_table_for_vis <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps)) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("feature") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Family_clean = stringr::str_replace(Family, "^f__", ""),
      Order_clean = stringr::str_replace(Order, "^o__", ""),
      Class_clean = stringr::str_replace(Class, "^c__", ""),
      Phylum_clean = stringr::str_replace(Phylum, "^p__", ""),
      # Get first non-NA taxonomy level for NA taxa
      first_non_na_tax = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(Family_clean) & Family_clean != "NA" & Family_clean != "" ~ Family_clean,
        !is.na(Order_clean) & Order_clean != "NA" & Order_clean != "" ~ Order_clean,
        !is.na(Class_clean) & Class_clean != "NA" & Class_clean != "" ~ Class_clean,
        !is.na(Phylum_clean) & Phylum_clean != "NA" & Phylum_clean != "" ~ Phylum_clean,
        TRUE ~ feature
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(feature, first_non_na_tax)
  
  maaslin2_sig <- maaslin2_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(q < 0.1) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(tax_table_for_vis, by = "feature") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      # Replace NA genus_species with Family level (or other taxonomy)
      genus_species = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(genus_species) | genus_species == "NA" | genus_species == "" | 
          stringr::str_starts(genus_species, "seq") ~
          stringr::str_replace_all(first_non_na_tax, "^(g__|f__|o__|c__|p__|k__)", ""),
        TRUE ~ stringr::str_replace_all(genus_species, "^(g__|f__|o__|c__|p__|k__)", "")
      ),
      # Create comparison labels for subtitle
      comparison_label = dplyr::case_when(
        metadata == "carbohydrate" & value == "RDC" ~ "RDC vs No Added Carb (positive = more in RDC)",
        metadata == "carbohydrate" & value == "SDC" ~ "SDC vs No Added Carb (positive = more in SDC)",
        metadata == "group" & value == "Obese" ~ "Obese vs Healthy (positive = more in Obese)",
        metadata == "timepoint" & value == "48H" ~ "48H vs 0H (positive = more at 48H)",
        metadata == "timepoint" & value == "72H" ~ "72H vs 0H (positive = more at 72H)",
        TRUE ~ paste0(value, " vs Reference")
      ),
      significance = dplyr::case_when(
        q < 0.001 ~ "***",
        q < 0.01 ~ "**",
        q < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      display_label = paste0(genus_species, " (", metadata, "=", value, ")", significance),
      full_label = display_label,
      metadata_value = paste0(metadata, "=", value)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-first_non_na_tax)
  
  # Plot 1: Coefficient effect sizes by metadata variable
  maaslin2_effects_plot <- ggplot(
    maaslin2_sig,
    aes(x = coef, y = reorder(full_label, coef))
  ) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = metadata_value), alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    scale_fill_scfa() +
    labs(
      title = "MaAsLin2 Results: Significant Associations",
      subtitle = "Coefficient Effect Sizes by Variable",
      x = "Coefficient (Effect Size)",
      y = "Features",
      caption = "*** q<0.001, ** q<0.01, * q<0.05"
    ) +
    theme_scfa() +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  print(maaslin2_effects_plot)
  
  # Plot 2: Volcano plot with ggrepel labels
  sig_points <- maaslin2_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(q < 0.1) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(tax_table_for_vis, by = "feature") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      # Replace NA genus_species with Family level (or other taxonomy)
      genus_species_clean = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(genus_species) | genus_species == "NA" | genus_species == "" | 
          stringr::str_starts(genus_species, "seq") ~
          stringr::str_replace_all(first_non_na_tax, "^(g__|f__|o__|c__|p__|k__)", ""),
        TRUE ~ stringr::str_replace_all(genus_species, "^(g__|f__|o__|c__|p__|k__)", "")
      ),
      genus_label = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(genus_species_clean) & stringr::str_detect(genus_species_clean, " ") ~ 
          stringr::str_extract(genus_species_clean, "^[^ ]+"),
        !is.na(genus_species_clean) ~ genus_species_clean,
        TRUE ~ stringr::str_replace_all(first_non_na_tax, "^(g__|f__|o__|c__|p__|k__)", "")
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-first_non_na_tax)
  
  maaslin2_volcano_plot <- ggplot(
    maaslin2_tbl,
    aes(x = coef, y = -log10(q))
  ) +
    geom_point(aes(color = q < 0.1), alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.1), linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = sig_points,
      aes(label = genus_label),
      size = 3,
      color = "#E31A1C",
      fontface = "bold",
      max.overlaps = 20,
      min.segment.length = 0.1,
      box.padding = 0.3,
      point.padding = 0.2,
      segment.color = "gray50",
      segment.alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("FALSE" = "gray70", "TRUE" = "#E31A1C"),
      name = "Significant",
      labels = c("FALSE" = "q ≥ 0.1", "TRUE" = "q < 0.1")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "MaAsLin2 Volcano Plot",
      subtitle = "Effect Size vs Statistical Significance",
      x = "Coefficient (Effect Size)",
      y = "-log10(q-value)",
      caption = "Red dashed line: q = 0.1 threshold; Labels show significant taxa"
    ) +
    theme_scfa() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  
  print(maaslin2_volcano_plot)
  
  # Plot 3: Top effects by metadata variable
  top_effects <- maaslin2_sig %>%
    dplyr::group_by(metadata) %>%
    dplyr::slice_max(abs(coef), n = 10) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      # Create dynamic subtitle per metadata variable
      subtitle_text = dplyr::case_when(
        metadata == "carbohydrate" ~ "RDC vs No Added Carb (pos=more in RDC); SDC vs No Added Carb (pos=more in SDC)",
        metadata == "group" ~ "Obese vs Healthy (positive = more in Obese)",
        metadata == "timepoint" ~ "48H vs 0H (pos=more at 48H); 72H vs 0H (pos=more at 72H)",
        TRUE ~ paste0("Comparison: ", metadata)
      )
    )
  
  # Create subtitle that combines all comparisons
  all_comparisons <- top_effects %>%
    dplyr::distinct(metadata, comparison_label) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(metadata) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(comparisons = paste(comparison_label, collapse = "; ")) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(all_text = paste(metadata, ":", comparisons, collapse = " | "))
  
  subtitle_text <- if (nrow(all_comparisons) > 0) {
    paste0("Top 10 largest effects per metadata variable. Comparisons: ", all_comparisons$all_text[1])
  } else {
    "Top 10 largest effects per metadata variable"
  }
  
  maaslin2_top_effects_plot <- ggplot(
    top_effects,
    aes(x = coef, y = reorder(genus_species, coef))
  ) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = metadata), alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    scale_fill_scfa() +
    labs(
      title = "MaAsLin2: Top Effects by Variable",
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      x = "Coefficient (Effect Size)",
      y = "Genus Species"
    ) +
    theme_scfa() +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~metadata, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1)
  
  print(maaslin2_top_effects_plot)
} else {
  cat("No significant MaAsLin2 results found (q < 0.1) for visualizations\n")
}
```

### 6.5.11 MaAsLin2 48H RDC vs SDC Analysis

```{r maaslin2-48h-rdc-sdc, echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE, cache.path="cache/integrated-"}
# Subset to 48H timepoint and RDC vs SDC only
ps_maaslin2_48h <- phyloseq::subset_samples(
  ps_maaslin2,
  timepoint == "48H" & carbohydrate %in% c("RDC", "SDC")
)

# Prepare data
maaslin2_48h_counts <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_maaslin2_48h))
maaslin2_48h_meta <- as(sample_data(ps_maaslin2_48h), "data.frame")
maaslin2_48h_meta$SampleID <- rownames(maaslin2_48h_meta)

maaslin2_48h_meta <- maaslin2_48h_meta %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    subject_id = as.character(subject_id),
    carbohydrate = as.factor(carbohydrate)
  )

# Run MaAsLin2 for 48H RDC vs SDC (suppress output)
maaslin2_48h_fit <- tryCatch({
  suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
    capture.output(
      maaslin2_48h_fit_result <- Maaslin2::Maaslin2(
        input_data = maaslin2_48h_counts,
        input_metadata = maaslin2_48h_meta,
        output = tempfile(pattern = "maaslin2_48h_", tmpdir = getwd()),  # Create temporary output directory
        min_prevalence = 0.05,
        normalization = "TSS",
        transform = "LOG",
        analysis_method = "LM",
        fixed_effects = c("carbohydrate"),
        random_effects = c("subject_id"),
        plot_heatmap = FALSE,
        plot_scatter = FALSE
      ),
      file = nullfile()
    )
  ))
  maaslin2_48h_fit_result
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("MaAsLin2 48H RDC vs SDC failed:", e$message, "\n")
  NULL
})

# Extract results
if (!is.null(maaslin2_48h_fit) && !is.null(maaslin2_48h_fit$results)) {
  maaslin2_48h_tbl <- maaslin2_48h_fit$results %>%
    dplyr::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(q = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH")) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(q) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      tax_table_df %>% dplyr::select(feature, Genus, genus_species),
      by = "feature"
    )
  
  cat("MaAsLin2 48H RDC vs SDC significant results (q < 0.1):", 
      nrow(maaslin2_48h_tbl %>% dplyr::filter(q < 0.1)), "\n")
} else {
  maaslin2_48h_tbl <- tibble(
    feature = character(0),
    metadata = character(0),
    value = character(0),
    coef = numeric(0),
    pval = numeric(0),
    q = numeric(0),
    genus_species = character(0)
  )
}
```

### 6.4.4 Genus Composition at 48H: No Carbohydrate vs RDC vs SDC

This alluvial plot shows the comparison of genus-level composition at 48H across the three carbohydrate conditions (No Added Carb, RDC, and SDC), highlighting the top 25 most abundant genera and including key differentially abundant taxa.

```{r genus-alluvial-48h-carb, echo=FALSE, fig.width=16, fig.height=12}
# Prepare data for alluvial diagram showing 48H comparison across carbohydrate conditions
ps_genus_rel_48h <- ps_genus_rel

# Filter to 48H only
ps_genus_rel_48h <- phyloseq::subset_samples(ps_genus_rel_48h, timepoint == "48H")

# Extract data
otu_mat_48h <- as.matrix(otu_table(ps_genus_rel_48h))
if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_genus_rel_48h)) {
  otu_mat_48h <- t(otu_mat_48h)
}

tax_df_48h <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_genus_rel_48h))
meta_df_48h <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_genus_rel_48h)) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID")

# Create long format data
alluvial_data_48h_raw <- otu_mat_48h %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("ASV") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-ASV, names_to = "SampleID", values_to = "Abundance") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    tax_df_48h %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("ASV") %>% dplyr::select(ASV, Genus),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    meta_df_48h %>% dplyr::select(SampleID, carbohydrate),
    by = "SampleID"
  )

# Remove NA values and filter to only valid combinations
alluvial_data_48h_clean <- alluvial_data_48h_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(Abundance),
    !is.na(Genus),
    !is.na(carbohydrate),
    carbohydrate != "NA"
  )

# Group by Genus and carbohydrate to get mean abundance at 48H
alluvial_data_48h_grouped <- alluvial_data_48h_clean %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genus, carbohydrate) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_abundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mean_abundance = ifelse(is.nan(mean_abundance) | is.na(mean_abundance), 0, mean_abundance)
  )

# Get top 25 genera for visualization (use max abundance across carbohydrate conditions)
top_genera_48h_by_abundance <- alluvial_data_48h_grouped %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genus) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(max_abund = max(mean_abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(max_abund)) %>%
  head(25) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Genus)

# Define genera that are important from DA analysis and should be included
da_important_genera_48h <- c(
  "g_Fusicatenibacter",
  "g__Fusicatenibacter",
  "Fusicatenibacter",
  "g_Fusicatenibacters",
  "g__Fusicatenibacters",
  "Fusicatenibacters",
  "g_Hungatella",
  "g__Hungatella",
  "Hungatella",
  "g_Eggerthella",
  "g__Eggerthella",
  "Eggerthella",
  "g_Peptoniphilus",
  "g__Peptoniphilus",
  "Peptoniphilus"
)

# Check which of these genera exist in the 48H data
available_genera_48h_from_tax <- unique(tax_df_48h$Genus)

# Check exact matches first
da_genera_48h_in_data <- da_important_genera_48h[da_important_genera_48h %in% available_genera_48h_from_tax]

# Also check for variations
da_genera_48h_variations <- available_genera_48h_from_tax[
  stringr::str_detect(available_genera_48h_from_tax, regex("Fusicatenibacter|Hungatella|Eggerthella|Peptoniphilus", ignore_case = TRUE))
]

# Combine exact matches and variations
da_genera_48h_found <- unique(c(da_genera_48h_in_data, da_genera_48h_variations))

# Combine top 25 by abundance with DA-important genera
# Remove duplicates and keep up to 29 genera total (25 + up to 4 DA genera)
top_genera_48h_alluvial <- unique(c(top_genera_48h_by_abundance, da_genera_48h_found))
if (length(top_genera_48h_alluvial) > 29) {
  # If we have more than 29, prioritize top 25 by abundance, then add DA genera
  top_genera_48h_alluvial <- c(
    top_genera_48h_by_abundance,
    setdiff(da_genera_48h_found, top_genera_48h_by_abundance)
  )[1:min(29, length(top_genera_48h_alluvial))]
}

# Filter to top genera and add "Other" category
alluvial_48h_plot_data_pre_complete <- alluvial_data_48h_grouped %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Genus_grouped = ifelse(Genus %in% top_genera_48h_alluvial, as.character(Genus), "Other")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genus_grouped, carbohydrate) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Abundance = sum(mean_abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Abundance = ifelse(is.nan(Abundance) | is.na(Abundance), 0, Abundance)
  )

# Ensure all combinations exist (Genus × carbohydrate)
alluvial_48h_plot_data <- alluvial_48h_plot_data_pre_complete %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    Genus_grouped = c(unique(alluvial_48h_plot_data_pre_complete$Genus_grouped), "Other"),
    carbohydrate = c("No Added Carb", "RDC", "SDC"),
    fill = list(Abundance = 0)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(carbohydrate))

# Clean genus names for display (remove g__ prefix)

alluvial_48h_plot_data <- alluvial_48h_plot_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    Genus_display != "",
    !is.na(Genus_grouped),

# Create alluvial plot showing flow between carbohydrate conditions

alluvial_48h_plot_data_labeled <- alluvial_48h_plot_data %>%

    x = "Carbohydrate Condition",

print(alluvial_48h_plot)

if (length(da_genera_48h_found) > 0) {

}
```

## 6.6 Absolute Abundances

Relative abundance data (compositional) can mask true changes in microbial load. To address this, we integrated qPCR-derived total genome copy estimates per sample to convert relative abundances to absolute abundances (genome copies per sample). This allows us to distinguish between compositional shifts versus true changes in microbial load.

### 6.6.1 Integration of qPCR Data

```{r absolute-abundance-integration, echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE, cache.path="cache/integrated-"}
# Load qPCR data
qpcr_file <- "../microbiome_analysis/zr24558.16S_250813.zymo/00...AllSamples.Bac16Sv34/Sample_Information/absolute.abundance.csv"
qpcr_data_raw <- readr::read_csv(qpcr_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
qpcr_data <- qpcr_data_raw %>%
  janitor::clean_names()

# Find the genome copies column (original was "genome_copies_per_ul*" which becomes "genome_copies_per_ul" after clean_names)
# Check for exact match first, then look for columns containing the pattern
genome_cols <- colnames(qpcr_data)[stringr::str_detect(colnames(qpcr_data), "genome_copies_per_ul")]
if (length(genome_cols) == 0) {
  stop("Could not find genome_copies_per_ul column in qPCR data")
}
# Use the first matching column (should be the one from "genome_copies_per_ul*")
genome_col <- genome_cols[1]

# Select only customer_label and the genome copies column, then rename to standardize
qpcr_data <- qpcr_data %>%
  dplyr::select(customer_label, !!rlang::sym(genome_col)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(genome_copies_per_ul = !!rlang::sym(genome_col))

# Clean customer_label to match sample metadata format
qpcr_data <- qpcr_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    customer_label = stringr::str_trim(customer_label),
    # Remove trailing periods and spaces
    customer_label = stringr::str_replace_all(customer_label, "\\.+$", ""),
    customer_label = stringr::str_replace_all(customer_label, "\\.\\.", ".")
  )

# Get sample metadata from phyloseq
sample_meta_abs <- data.frame(sample_data(ps)) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Create matching customer_label from SampleID if needed
    customer_label_match = dplyr::case_when(
      # Try direct match first
      SampleID %in% qpcr_data$customer_label ~ SampleID,
      # Try with different patterns
      stringr::str_detect(SampleID, "^S") ~ stringr::str_replace(SampleID, "^S", ""),
      TRUE ~ SampleID
    )
  )

# Match qPCR data to samples
# Try direct match first, then pattern matching
sample_meta_abs <- sample_meta_abs %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    qpcr_data,
    by = c("SampleID" = "customer_label")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # If no direct match, try customer_label_match
    genome_copies_per_ul = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(genome_copies_per_ul),
      dplyr::left_join(
        data.frame(customer_label_match = .$customer_label_match),
        qpcr_data %>% dplyr::select(customer_label, genome_copies_per_ul),
        by = c("customer_label_match" = "customer_label")
      )$genome_copies_per_ul,
      genome_copies_per_ul
    )
  )

# Calculate samples matched
matched_samples <- sum(!is.na(sample_meta_abs$genome_copies_per_ul))
cat("qPCR data integration:\n")
cat("- Total samples in phyloseq:", nrow(sample_meta_abs), "\n")
cat("- Samples matched to qPCR data:", matched_samples, "\n")
cat("- Match rate:", round(matched_samples / nrow(sample_meta_abs) * 100, 1), "%\n")
```

### 6.6.2 Conversion to Absolute Abundances

```{r absolute-abundance-conversion, echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE, cache.path="cache/integrated-"}
# Convert relative abundances to absolute abundances
# For each sample: absolute_abundance = relative_abundance × total_genome_copies

# Get relative abundance phyloseq object (genus-level)
ps_genus_abs <- ps_genus_rel

# Match genome copies to samples
sample_data(ps_genus_abs)$genome_copies_per_ul <- sample_meta_abs$genome_copies_per_ul[
  match(sample_names(ps_genus_abs), sample_meta_abs$SampleID)
]

# Create absolute abundance otu table
otu_rel <- as.matrix(otu_table(ps_genus_rel))
genome_copies <- sample_data(ps_genus_abs)$genome_copies_per_ul

# Convert to absolute abundances
otu_abs <- otu_rel
for (i in 1:ncol(otu_rel)) {
  if (!is.na(genome_copies[i])) {
    # Absolute abundance = relative abundance × total genome copies
    otu_abs[, i] <- otu_rel[, i] * genome_copies[i]
  } else {
    otu_abs[, i] <- NA
  }
}

# Create phyloseq object with absolute abundances
ps_genus_abs_obj <- ps_genus_abs
otu_table(ps_genus_abs_obj) <- otu_table(otu_abs, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)

cat("Absolute abundance conversion complete:\n")
cat("- Samples with qPCR data:", sum(!is.na(genome_copies)), "\n")
cat("- Samples without qPCR data:", sum(is.na(genome_copies)), "\n")
```

### 6.6.4 Fusicatenibacter Absolute Abundance Plots

```{r fusicatenibacter-absolute-abundance, echo=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
# Extract absolute abundance data for g__Fusicatenibacter
# Find all ASVs assigned to this genus
fusicatenibacter_taxa <- taxa_names(ps_genus_abs_obj)[
  stringr::str_detect(tax_table(ps_genus_abs_obj)[, "Genus"], regex("Fusicatenibacter", ignore_case = TRUE))
]

if (length(fusicatenibacter_taxa) > 0) {
  # Get absolute abundance for Fusicatenibacter genus
  # Sum across all ASVs if multiple
  if (length(fusicatenibacter_taxa) > 1) {
    fusicatenibacter_abs <- colSums(otu_table(ps_genus_abs_obj)[fusicatenibacter_taxa, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    fusicatenibacter_abs <- as.numeric(otu_table(ps_genus_abs_obj)[fusicatenibacter_taxa, ])
  }
  
  # Get metadata
  meta_abs <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_genus_abs_obj)) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      fusicatenibacter_abs_abund = fusicatenibacter_abs,
      # Filter out samples without qPCR data
      has_qpcr = !is.na(genome_copies_per_ul)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(has_qpcr) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(carbohydrate), !is.na(timepoint))
  
  # Calculate mean and SE by group, carbohydrate, and timepoint
  fusicatenibacter_summary <- meta_abs %>%
    dplyr::group_by(group, carbohydrate, timepoint) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      mean_abs_abund = mean(fusicatenibacter_abs_abund, na.rm = TRUE),
      se_abs_abund = sd(fusicatenibacter_abs_abund, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
      n = dplyr::n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      mean_abs_abund = ifelse(is.na(mean_abs_abund), 0, mean_abs_abund),
      se_abs_abund = ifelse(is.na(se_abs_abund), 0, se_abs_abund)
    )
  
  # Create plots
  # Plot 1: By group and carbohydrate, faceted by timepoint
  fusicatenibacter_plot1 <- ggplot(
    fusicatenibacter_summary,
    aes(x = carbohydrate, y = mean_abs_abund, fill = group)
  ) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = mean_abs_abund - se_abs_abund, ymax = mean_abs_abund + se_abs_abund),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      width = 0.2
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ timepoint, ncol = 2) +
    scale_fill_scfa() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    labs(
      title = "g__Fusicatenibacter Absolute Abundance",
      subtitle = "Mean ± SE genome copies per μL by group, carbohydrate, and timepoint",
      x = "Carbohydrate",
      y = "Absolute Abundance (genome copies/μL)",
      fill = "Group"
    ) +
    theme_scfa() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  print(fusicatenibacter_plot1)
  
  # Plot 2: Over time by carbohydrate and group
  fusicatenibacter_plot2 <- ggplot(
    fusicatenibacter_summary,
    aes(x = timepoint, y = mean_abs_abund, color = group, group = group)
  ) +
    geom_line(size = 1.2) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = mean_abs_abund - se_abs_abund, ymax = mean_abs_abund + se_abs_abund),
      width = 0.1
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ carbohydrate, ncol = 3) +
    scale_color_scfa() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    labs(
      title = "g__Fusicatenibacter Absolute Abundance Over Time",
      subtitle = "Mean ± SE genome copies per μL by carbohydrate type and group",
      x = "Timepoint",
      y = "Absolute Abundance (genome copies/μL)",
      color = "Group"
    ) +
    theme_scfa()
  
  print(fusicatenibacter_plot2)
  
} else {
  cat("No Fusicatenibacter taxa found in the data\n")
}
```

# 7. Integrated Analysis: Taxon–SCFA Relationships

This section integrates SCFA metabolomics with microbiome composition to identify taxa associated with SCFA concentrations. We model associations between microbial taxa and butyrate/propionate concentrations while accounting for carbohydrate type effects, using both relative and absolute abundance data.

## 7.1 Integration of SCFA Data with Microbiome Metadata

```{r scfa-microbiome-integration, echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE, cache.path="cache/integrated-"}
# Merge SCFA data with microbiome metadata
# SCFA uses: subject, group, carbohydrate_type, timepoint_hr
# Microbiome uses: subject_id, group, carbohydrate, timepoint

# Get SCFA concentrations at subject × carbohydrate × timepoint level
scfa_wide <- scfa_sample_data_long_factored %>%
  dplyr::filter(analyte %in% c("butyrate", "propionate")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(timepoint_hr %in% c("0", "48")) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(subject, group, carbohydrate_type, timepoint_hr),
    names_from = analyte,
    values_from = concentration,
    names_prefix = "scfa_"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    carbohydrate = dplyr::case_when(
      carbohydrate_type == "no_carbohydrate" ~ "No Added Carb",
      carbohydrate_type == "rapid_digestible" ~ "RDC",
      carbohydrate_type == "slow_digestible" ~ "SDC",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    timepoint = dplyr::case_when(
      timepoint_hr == "0" ~ "0H",
      timepoint_hr == "48" ~ "48H",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    group_micro = dplyr::case_when(
      group == "control" ~ "Healthy",
      group == "case" ~ "Obese",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(carbohydrate), !is.na(timepoint), !is.na(group_micro))

# Get microbiome sample metadata
micro_meta_merged <- data.frame(sample_data(ps)) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    subject_id = as.character(subject_id),
    # Extract numeric part of subject_id for matching (e.g., "84B" -> "84")
    subject_id_numeric = stringr::str_extract(subject_id, "^[0-9]+"),
    group = as.character(group),
    carbohydrate = as.character(carbohydrate),
    timepoint = as.character(timepoint)
  )

# Merge SCFA data with microbiome metadata
# Match on numeric subject ID (SCFA has numeric, microbiome has "84B" format)
micro_meta_scfa <- micro_meta_merged %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    scfa_wide,
    by = c(
      "subject_id_numeric" = "subject",
      "group" = "group_micro",
      "carbohydrate" = "carbohydrate",
      "timepoint" = "timepoint"
    )
  )
```

## 7.2 Taxon–Butyrate Associations

```{r taxon-butyrate-relative, echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE, cache.path="cache/integrated-"}
# Prepare data for analysis: relative abundance with butyrate
ps_butyrate_rel <- ps

# Update sample_data with SCFA concentrations
sample_data(ps_butyrate_rel)$butyrate <- micro_meta_scfa$scfa_butyrate[
  match(sample_names(ps_butyrate_rel), micro_meta_scfa$SampleID)
]

# Filter to samples with butyrate data
ps_butyrate_rel <- phyloseq::subset_samples(
  ps_butyrate_rel,
  !is.na(butyrate) & !is.na(carbohydrate) & !is.na(timepoint)
)

# Run ANCOM-BC2 for taxon ~ butyrate + carbohydrate
# Note: When using continuous variables, set global = FALSE and group = NULL
# or specify a group variable for structural zero detection
if (nsamples(ps_butyrate_rel) > 10 && ntaxa(ps_butyrate_rel) > 1) {
  ancombc2_butyrate_rel <- tryCatch({
    ANCOMBC::ancombc2(
      data = ps_butyrate_rel,
      fix_formula = "butyrate + carbohydrate",
      rand_formula = "(1|subject_id)",
      p_adj_method = "BH",
      prv_cut = 0.10,
      lib_cut = 1000,
      alpha = 0.05,
      group = "carbohydrate",  # Use carbohydrate as group for structural zeros
      struc_zero = TRUE,
      neg_lb = TRUE,
      global = TRUE,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("ANCOM-BC2 butyrate (relative) failed:", e$message, "
")
    NULL
  })
  
  if (!is.null(ancombc2_butyrate_rel) && !is.null(ancombc2_butyrate_rel$res)) {
    res_data <- ancombc2_butyrate_rel$res
    ancombc2_butyrate_tbl_rel <- tibble::tibble()
    ancombc2_butyrate_tbl_rel_full <- tibble::tibble()
    
    if ("q_butyrate" %in% colnames(res_data)) {
      # Full results for visualization
      ancombc2_butyrate_tbl_rel_full <- res_data %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          effect = "butyrate",
          beta = lfc_butyrate,
          se = se_butyrate,
          p_value = p_butyrate,
          q_value = q_butyrate
        ) %>%
        dplyr::select(taxon, effect, beta, se, p_value, q_value)
      
      # Significant results only
      ancombc2_butyrate_tbl_rel <- ancombc2_butyrate_tbl_rel_full %>%
        dplyr::filter(q_value < 0.1)
    }
  } else {
    ancombc2_butyrate_tbl_rel <- tibble::tibble()
    ancombc2_butyrate_tbl_rel_full <- tibble::tibble()
  }
} else {
  ancombc2_butyrate_tbl_rel <- tibble::tibble()
  ancombc2_butyrate_tbl_rel_full <- tibble::tibble()
}

# Run MaAsLin2 for taxon ~ butyrate + carbohydrate
# Ensure count matrix columns match metadata rownames
maaslin2_butyrate_counts_rel <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_butyrate_rel))
if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_butyrate_rel)) {
  maaslin2_butyrate_counts_rel <- t(maaslin2_butyrate_counts_rel)
}

# Prepare metadata with rownames matching count matrix column names
maaslin2_butyrate_meta_rel <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_butyrate_rel)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    subject_id = as.character(subject_id),
    carbohydrate = as.factor(carbohydrate),
    butyrate = as.numeric(butyrate)
  )
# Ensure rownames match count matrix column names
rownames(maaslin2_butyrate_meta_rel) <- sample_names(ps_butyrate_rel)

maaslin2_butyrate_rel <- tryCatch({
  suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
    capture.output(
      maaslin2_butyrate_rel_result <- Maaslin2::Maaslin2(
        input_data = maaslin2_butyrate_counts_rel,
        input_metadata = maaslin2_butyrate_meta_rel,
        output = tempfile(pattern = "maaslin2_butyrate_rel_", tmpdir = getwd()),
        min_prevalence = 0.05,
        normalization = "TSS",
        transform = "LOG",
        analysis_method = "LM",
        fixed_effects = c("butyrate", "carbohydrate"),
        random_effects = c("subject_id"),
        plot_heatmap = FALSE,
        plot_scatter = FALSE
      ),
      file = nullfile()
    )
  ))
  maaslin2_butyrate_rel_result
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("MaAsLin2 butyrate (relative) failed:", e$message, "
")
  NULL
})

if (!is.null(maaslin2_butyrate_rel) && !is.null(maaslin2_butyrate_rel$results)) {
  # Full results for visualization
  maaslin2_butyrate_tbl_rel_full <- maaslin2_butyrate_rel$results %>%
    dplyr::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(q = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH")) %>%
    dplyr::filter(metadata == "butyrate") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(q)
  
  # Significant results only
  maaslin2_butyrate_tbl_rel <- maaslin2_butyrate_tbl_rel_full %>%
    dplyr::filter(q < 0.1)
} else {
  maaslin2_butyrate_tbl_rel <- tibble::tibble()
  maaslin2_butyrate_tbl_rel_full <- tibble::tibble()
}
```

### 7.2.1 ANCOM-BC2 and MaAsLin2 Visualizations: Butyrate Associations

```{r taxon-butyrate-visualizations, echo=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
# ANCOM-BC2 Forest Plot for Butyrate
if (exists("ancombc2_butyrate_tbl_rel_full") && nrow(ancombc2_butyrate_tbl_rel_full) > 0) {
  forest_butyrate_data <- ancombc2_butyrate_tbl_rel_full %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      ci_lower = beta - 1.96 * se,
      ci_upper = beta + 1.96 * se,
      taxon_label = stringr::str_replace(taxon, "^g__", ""),
      significance = dplyr::case_when(
        q_value < 0.001 ~ "q < 0.001",
        q_value < 0.01 ~ "q < 0.01",
        q_value < 0.05 ~ "q < 0.05",
        q_value < 0.1 ~ "q < 0.1",
        TRUE ~ "q ≥ 0.1"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(beta)))
  
  # Show top 25 taxa by effect size or all significant ones
  if (sum(forest_butyrate_data$q_value < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
    forest_butyrate_plot_data <- forest_butyrate_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(q_value < 0.1) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(beta))) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 25)
  } else {
    forest_butyrate_plot_data <- forest_butyrate_data %>%
      dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(beta))) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 25)
  }
  
  if (nrow(forest_butyrate_plot_data) > 0) {
    ancombc2_butyrate_forest <- ggplot(
      forest_butyrate_plot_data,
      aes(x = beta, y = reorder(taxon_label, beta), color = significance)
    ) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
      geom_point(size = 2) +
      geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_lower, xmax = ci_upper), 
                     height = 0.2, alpha = 0.8) +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c("q < 0.001" = "#d73027", 
                   "q < 0.01" = "#f46d43",
                   "q < 0.05" = "#fdae61", 
                   "q < 0.1" = "#fee08b",
                   "q ≥ 0.1" = "gray70"),
        name = "FDR-adjusted\np-value"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "ANCOM-BC2: Taxon Associations with Butyrate",
        subtitle = "Effect sizes (log-fold change per unit butyrate) with 95% confidence intervals",
        x = "Log-fold change (β)",
        y = "Taxon"
      ) +
      theme_scfa() +
      theme(
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.position = "bottom"
      )
    
    print(ancombc2_butyrate_forest)
  }
} else {
  cat("No ANCOM-BC2 butyrate results available for visualization\n")
}

# MaAsLin2 Volcano Plot for Butyrate
if (exists("maaslin2_butyrate_tbl_rel_full") && nrow(maaslin2_butyrate_tbl_rel_full) > 0) {
  # Get taxonomy for labels
  tax_table_butyrate <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_butyrate_rel)) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("feature") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Genus_clean = stringr::str_replace(Genus, "^g__", ""),
      Family_clean = stringr::str_replace(Family, "^f__", ""),
      genus_label = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(Genus_clean) & Genus_clean != "NA" & Genus_clean != "" ~ Genus_clean,
        !is.na(Family_clean) & Family_clean != "NA" & Family_clean != "" ~ Family_clean,
        TRUE ~ feature
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(feature, genus_label)
  
  maaslin2_butyrate_plot_data <- maaslin2_butyrate_tbl_rel_full %>%
    dplyr::left_join(tax_table_butyrate, by = "feature")
  
  sig_points_butyrate <- maaslin2_butyrate_plot_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(q < 0.1)
  
  maaslin2_butyrate_volcano <- ggplot(
    maaslin2_butyrate_plot_data,
    aes(x = coef, y = -log10(q))
  ) +
    geom_point(aes(color = q < 0.1), alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.1), linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = sig_points_butyrate,
      aes(label = genus_label),
      size = 3,
      color = "#E31A1C",
      fontface = "bold",
      max.overlaps = 20,
      min.segment.length = 0.1
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("FALSE" = "gray70", "TRUE" = "#E31A1C"),
      name = "Significant",
      labels = c("FALSE" = "q ≥ 0.1", "TRUE" = "q < 0.1")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "MaAsLin2: Taxon Associations with Butyrate",
      subtitle = "Effect Size vs Statistical Significance",
      x = "Coefficient (Effect Size)",
      y = "-log10(q-value)",
      caption = "Red dashed line: q = 0.1 threshold"
    ) +
    theme_scfa() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  print(maaslin2_butyrate_volcano)
} else {
  cat("No MaAsLin2 butyrate results available for visualization\n")
}
```

```{r taxon-propionate-visualizations, echo=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
      forest_propionate_plot_data,
      aes(x = beta, y = reorder(taxon_label, beta), color = significance)
    ) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
      geom_point(size = 2) +
      geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_lower, xmax = ci_upper), 
                     height = 0.2, alpha = 0.8) +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c("q < 0.001" = "#d73027", 
                   "q < 0.01" = "#f46d43",
                   "q < 0.05" = "#fdae61", 
                   "q < 0.1" = "#fee08b",
                   "q ≥ 0.1" = "gray70"),
        name = "FDR-adjusted\np-value"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "ANCOM-BC2: Taxon Associations with Propionate",
        subtitle = "Effect sizes (log-fold change per unit propionate) with 95% confidence intervals",
        x = "Log-fold change (β)",
        y = "Taxon"
      ) +
      theme_scfa() +
      theme(
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.position = "bottom"
      )
    
    print(ancombc2_propionate_forest)
  }
} else {

if (exists("maaslin2_propionate_tbl_rel_full") && nrow(maaslin2_propionate_tbl_rel_full) > 0) {

        !is.na(Family_clean) & Family_clean != "NA" & Family_clean != "" ~ Family_clean,
        TRUE ~ feature
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(feature, genus_label)
```

```{r fusicatenibacter-scfa-correlations, echo=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
  # Print correlation statistics summary
  cat("\nFusicatenibacter-SCFA Correlations (48H, SDC only):\n")
  cat("==================================================\n")
  
  if (!is.na(r2_butyrate)) {
    cat(sprintf("Butyrate:\n"))
```

## 7.5 Responder vs Non-Responder Analysis

```{r responder-nonresponder, echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE, cache.path="cache/integrated-"}
# Define responder groups based on delta SCFA (48H - 0H)
# Calculate delta for butyrate and propionate
scfa_delta <- scfa_sample_data_long_factored %>%
  dplyr::filter(analyte %in% c("butyrate", "propionate")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(timepoint_hr %in% c("0", "48")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(subject, group, carbohydrate_type, analyte) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    conc_0h = concentration[timepoint_hr == "0"][1],
    conc_48h = concentration[timepoint_hr == "48"][1],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    delta_48h_0h = conc_48h - conc_0h,
    # Map to microbiome labels
    carbohydrate = dplyr::case_when(
      carbohydrate_type == "no_carbohydrate" ~ "No Added Carb",
      carbohydrate_type == "rapid_digestible" ~ "RDC",
      carbohydrate_type == "slow_digestible" ~ "SDC",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    group_micro = dplyr::case_when(
      group == "control" ~ "Healthy",
      group == "case" ~ "Obese",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(delta_48h_0h), !is.na(carbohydrate), !is.na(group_micro))

# Define responder/non-responder using median split for each analyte
# Separate by carbohydrate type for more relevant comparisons
responder_status <- scfa_delta %>%
  dplyr::group_by(analyte, carbohydrate) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    median_delta = median(delta_48h_0h, na.rm = TRUE),
    responder_status = dplyr::if_else(
      delta_48h_0h >= median_delta,
      "Responder",
      "Non-Responder"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(subject, group_micro, carbohydrate, analyte, responder_status)

# Pivot to wide format for overlap analysis
responder_wide <- responder_status %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(subject, group_micro, carbohydrate),
    names_from = analyte,
    values_from = responder_status,
    names_prefix = "responder_"
  )

# Examine overlap in responder status
cat("Responder Status Overlap:
")
cat("- Total subjects:", nrow(responder_wide), "
")
if ("responder_butyrate" %in% colnames(responder_wide) && 
    "responder_propionate" %in% colnames(responder_wide)) {
  overlap_table <- table(
    Butyrate = responder_wide$responder_butyrate,
    Propionate = responder_wide$responder_propionate,
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
  print(overlap_table)
  
  # Calculate overlap statistics
  both_responder <- sum(responder_wide$responder_butyrate == "Responder" & 
                        responder_wide$responder_propionate == "Responder", 
                        na.rm = TRUE)
  both_non_responder <- sum(responder_wide$responder_butyrate == "Non-Responder" & 
                           responder_wide$responder_propionate == "Non-Responder", 
                           na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("- Both Responder: %d (%.1f%%)
", both_responder, 
              100 * both_responder / nrow(responder_wide)))
  cat(sprintf("- Both Non-Responder: %d (%.1f%%)
", both_non_responder, 
              100 * both_non_responder / nrow(responder_wide)))
}

# Merge responder status with microbiome metadata at 48H
ps_48h_resp <- phyloseq::subset_samples(ps, timepoint == "48H")

# Add responder status to sample_data
# Extract numeric subject ID for matching
sample_meta_resp <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_48h_resp)) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    subject_id_numeric = stringr::str_extract(as.character(subject_id), "^[0-9]+")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    responder_wide,
    by = c("subject_id_numeric" = "subject", 
           "group" = "group_micro", 
           "carbohydrate" = "carbohydrate")
  )

# Update phyloseq sample_data
sample_data(ps_48h_resp)$responder_butyrate <- sample_meta_resp$responder_butyrate
sample_data(ps_48h_resp)$responder_propionate <- sample_meta_resp$responder_propionate

cat("
48H Microbiome Composition Comparison:
")
cat("- Samples with responder status:", 
    sum(!is.na(sample_data(ps_48h_resp)$responder_butyrate)), "
")
```

## 7.6 Microbial Composition Differences: Butyrate Responders vs Non-Responders

To investigate whether individual variation in SCFA response is associated with differences in microbiome composition, we classified subjects as "Responders" or "Non-Responders" based on their change in SCFA concentration from baseline (0H) to 48 hours (48H). 

**Definition of Responder Status:**
- For each SCFA (butyrate and propionate) and each carbohydrate condition (RDC and SDC), we calculated the delta change: Δ = [SCFA]₄₈ₕ - [SCFA]₀ₕ
- Subjects were classified separately for each analyte and carbohydrate type using a median split approach
- **Responders**: Subjects with Δ ≥ median Δ for that specific analyte-carbohydrate combination
- **Non-Responders**: Subjects with Δ < median Δ for that specific analyte-carbohydrate combination

This approach allows us to identify whether individuals who show greater increases in SCFA production (responders) have distinct microbial communities compared to those with smaller increases (non-responders), potentially revealing microbiome features associated with enhanced SCFA production capacity.

In this section, we compare the microbial composition (alpha diversity, beta diversity, and community structure) between butyrate responders and non-responders at the 48H timepoint, focusing on samples from RDC and SDC conditions (excluding No Added Carb controls).

```{r butyrate-responder-composition, echo=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
# Compare microbial composition between butyrate responder groups at 48H
ps_48h_butyrate_resp <- phyloseq::subset_samples(
  ps_48h_resp,
  !is.na(responder_butyrate) & carbohydrate != "No Added Carb"
)

if (nsamples(ps_48h_butyrate_resp) > 5) {
  # Alpha diversity comparison
  alpha_butyrate_resp <- estimate_richness(
    ps_48h_butyrate_resp,
    measures = c("Observed", "Shannon", "Simpson")
  ) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      data.frame(sample_data(ps_48h_butyrate_resp)) %>%
        tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
        dplyr::select(SampleID, responder_butyrate, carbohydrate),
      by = "SampleID"
    )
  
  # Plot alpha diversity
  alpha_butyrate_resp_long <- alpha_butyrate_resp %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(Observed, Shannon, Simpson),
      names_to = "metric",
      values_to = "value"
    )
  
  alpha_resp_plot <- ggplot(
    alpha_butyrate_resp_long,
    aes(x = responder_butyrate, y = value, fill = responder_butyrate)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
    ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
      aes(group = responder_butyrate),
      method = "wilcox.test",
      label = "p.format",
      label.y = Inf,
      vjust = 1.5,
      size = 3.5
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_scfa() +
    labs(
      title = "Alpha Diversity: Butyrate Responders vs Non-Responders (48H)",
      subtitle = "Comparison across RDC and SDC conditions (Wilcoxon test p-values shown)",
      x = "Butyrate Response Status",
      y = "Alpha Diversity",
      fill = "Response Status"
    ) +
    theme_scfa() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  print(alpha_resp_plot)
  
  # Calculate and display Wilcoxon test statistics
  alpha_butyrate_wilcox <- tryCatch({
    alpha_butyrate_resp_long %>%
      dplyr::group_by(metric) %>%
      dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(responder_butyrate) == 2) %>%
      rstatix::wilcox_test(value ~ responder_butyrate, p.adjust.method = "BH") %>%
      rstatix::add_significance() %>%
      dplyr::ungroup()
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error calculating alpha_butyrate_wilcox:", e$message, "\n")
    tibble::tibble()
  })
  
  # Check available columns and select appropriate ones
  if (nrow(alpha_butyrate_wilcox) > 0) {
    # Check what columns exist (p.adj vs p_adjust)
    p_adj_col <- intersect(c("p.adj", "p_adjust", "adj.p.value"), names(alpha_butyrate_wilcox))
    p_adj_col <- if (length(p_adj_col) > 0) p_adj_col[1] else NULL
    
    p_signif_col <- intersect(c("p.adj.signif", "p_adjust_signif", "signif"), names(alpha_butyrate_wilcox))
    p_signif_col <- if (length(p_signif_col) > 0) p_signif_col[1] else NULL
    
    # Create adjusted p-value if it doesn't exist
    if (is.null(p_adj_col) && "p" %in% names(alpha_butyrate_wilcox)) {
      alpha_butyrate_wilcox$p_adj <- p.adjust(alpha_butyrate_wilcox$p, method = "BH")
    } else if (!is.null(p_adj_col)) {
      alpha_butyrate_wilcox$p_adj <- alpha_butyrate_wilcox[[p_adj_col]]
    } else {
      alpha_butyrate_wilcox$p_adj <- NA_real_
    }
    
    # Create significance column if it doesn't exist
    if (is.null(p_signif_col)) {
      alpha_butyrate_wilcox$p_adj_signif <- dplyr::case_when(
        alpha_butyrate_wilcox$p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
        alpha_butyrate_wilcox$p_adj < 0.01 ~ "**",
        alpha_butyrate_wilcox$p_adj < 0.05 ~ "*",
        alpha_butyrate_wilcox$p_adj < 0.1 ~ ".",
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      )
    } else {
      alpha_butyrate_wilcox$p_adj_signif <- alpha_butyrate_wilcox[[p_signif_col]]
    }
    
    cat("\nWilcoxon Test Results: Butyrate Responders vs Non-Responders (Alpha Diversity)\n")
    cat("================================================================================\n")
    print(alpha_butyrate_wilcox %>%
            dplyr::select(metric, group1, group2, p, p_adj, p_adj_signif) %>%
            dplyr::rename(
              Metric = metric,
              Group1 = group1,
              Group2 = group2,
              `p value` = p,
              `p adjusted` = p_adj,
              Significance = p_adj_signif
            ))
  } else {
    cat("\nWilcoxon Test Results: Butyrate Responders vs Non-Responders (Alpha Diversity)\n")
    cat("================================================================================\n")
    cat("Insufficient data for Wilcoxon tests\n")
  }
  
  # Beta diversity comparison
  ps_48h_butyrate_resp_rel <- microbiome::transform(
    ps_48h_butyrate_resp, 
    "compositional"
  )
  
  dist_bray_resp <- phyloseq::distance(
    ps_48h_butyrate_resp_rel, 
    method = "bray"
  )
  
  meta_resp <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_48h_butyrate_resp_rel))
  
  # PCoA
  pcoa_resp <- ape::pcoa(as.matrix(dist_bray_resp))
  pcoa_df_resp <- data.frame(
    PC1 = pcoa_resp$vectors[, 1],
    PC2 = pcoa_resp$vectors[, 2],
    responder_butyrate = meta_resp$responder_butyrate,
    carbohydrate = meta_resp$carbohydrate
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(responder_butyrate))
  
  pcoa_plot_resp <- ggplot(
    pcoa_df_resp,
    aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = responder_butyrate)
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    stat_ellipse(aes(group = responder_butyrate), level = 0.68) +
    facet_wrap(~ carbohydrate) +
    scale_color_scfa() +
    labs(
      title = "Beta Diversity: Butyrate Responders vs Non-Responders (48H)",
      subtitle = "Bray-Curtis PCoA",
      x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100 * pcoa_resp$values$Relative_eig[1], 1), "%)"),
      y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100 * pcoa_resp$values$Relative_eig[2], 1), "%)"),
      color = "Response Status"
    ) +
    theme_scfa()
  
  print(pcoa_plot_resp)
  
  # PERMANOVA
  perm_resp <- vegan::adonis2(
    dist_bray_resp ~ responder_butyrate * carbohydrate,
    data = meta_resp,
    strata = meta_resp$subject_id,
    permutations = 999
  )
  
  cat("
PERMANOVA: Butyrate Responder Status (48H):
")
  print(perm_resp)
  
} else {
  cat("Insufficient data for butyrate responder composition comparison
")
}
```

### 7.6.1 Differential Abundance Analysis: Butyrate Responders vs Non-Responders

To identify specific taxa that differ between butyrate responders and non-responders, we performed differential abundance analysis using ANCOM-BC2 and MaAsLin2.

```{r butyrate-responder-da, echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE, cache.path="cache/integrated-", fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
# Prepare genus-level phyloseq object for DA analysis
ps_butyrate_resp_genus <- tax_glom(ps_48h_butyrate_resp, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = FALSE)
ps_butyrate_resp_genus <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_butyrate_resp_genus) > 0, ps_butyrate_resp_genus)

# Filter to samples with responder status
ps_butyrate_resp_genus <- phyloseq::subset_samples(
  ps_butyrate_resp_genus,
  !is.na(responder_butyrate) & carbohydrate != "No Added Carb"
)

# ANCOM-BC2 Analysis
if (nsamples(ps_butyrate_resp_genus) > 10 && ntaxa(ps_butyrate_resp_genus) > 1) {
  # Remove samples with too many zeros
  zero_prop <- apply(otu_table(ps_butyrate_resp_genus), 2, function(x) sum(x == 0) / length(x))
  problematic_samples <- names(zero_prop[zero_prop > 0.95])
  
  if (length(problematic_samples) > 0) {
    ps_butyrate_resp_genus_clean <- subset_samples(
      ps_butyrate_resp_genus, 
      !sample_names(ps_butyrate_resp_genus) %in% problematic_samples
    )
  } else {
    ps_butyrate_resp_genus_clean <- ps_butyrate_resp_genus
  }
  
  # Ensure responder_butyrate is a factor
  sample_data(ps_butyrate_resp_genus_clean)$responder_butyrate <- as.factor(
    sample_data(ps_butyrate_resp_genus_clean)$responder_butyrate
  )
  
  ancombc2_butyrate_resp <- tryCatch({
    ANCOMBC::ancombc2(
      data = ps_butyrate_resp_genus_clean,
      tax_level = "Genus",
      fix_formula = "responder_butyrate + carbohydrate",
      rand_formula = "(1|subject_id)",
      p_adj_method = "BH",
      prv_cut = 0.10,
      lib_cut = 0,
      s0_perc = 0.05,
      group = "responder_butyrate",
      struc_zero = TRUE,
      neg_lb = TRUE,
      alpha = 0.05,
      global = TRUE,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("ANCOM-BC2 butyrate responder failed:", e$message, "\n")
    NULL
  })
  
  # Extract ANCOM-BC2 results
  if (!is.null(ancombc2_butyrate_resp) && !is.null(ancombc2_butyrate_resp$res)) {
    res_data_butyrate_resp <- ancombc2_butyrate_resp$res
    
    # Get effect for responder_butyrateResponder (vs Non-Responder as reference)
    effect_name <- "responder_butyrateResponder"
    lfc_col <- paste0("lfc_", effect_name)
    se_col <- paste0("se_", effect_name)
    p_col <- paste0("p_", effect_name)
    q_col <- paste0("q_", effect_name)
    
    if (all(c(lfc_col, se_col, p_col, q_col) %in% colnames(res_data_butyrate_resp))) {
      ancombc2_butyrate_resp_tbl <- res_data_butyrate_resp %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          effect = "Responder vs Non-Responder",
          beta = .data[[lfc_col]],
          se = .data[[se_col]],
          p_value = .data[[p_col]],
          q_value = .data[[q_col]]
        ) %>%
        dplyr::select(taxon, effect, beta, se, p_value, q_value) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(q_value)
      
      cat("ANCOM-BC2 butyrate responder:", 
          sum(ancombc2_butyrate_resp_tbl$q_value < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),
          "significant taxa (q < 0.1)\n")
    } else {
      ancombc2_butyrate_resp_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
        taxon = character(0),
        effect = character(0),
        beta = numeric(0),
        se = numeric(0),
        p_value = numeric(0),
        q_value = numeric(0)
      )
    }
  } else {
    ancombc2_butyrate_resp_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
      taxon = character(0),
      effect = character(0),
      beta = numeric(0),
      se = numeric(0),
      p_value = numeric(0),
      q_value = numeric(0)
    )
  }
} else {
  ancombc2_butyrate_resp_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
    taxon = character(0),
    effect = character(0),
    beta = numeric(0),
    se = numeric(0),
    p_value = numeric(0),
    q_value = numeric(0)
  )
  cat("Insufficient samples for ANCOM-BC2 butyrate responder analysis\n")
}

# MaAsLin2 Analysis
if (nsamples(ps_butyrate_resp_genus) > 5 && ntaxa(ps_butyrate_resp_genus) > 1) {
  maaslin2_butyrate_resp_counts <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_butyrate_resp_genus))
  if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_butyrate_resp_genus)) {
    maaslin2_butyrate_resp_counts <- t(maaslin2_butyrate_resp_counts)
  }
  
  maaslin2_butyrate_resp_meta <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_butyrate_resp_genus)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      subject_id = as.character(subject_id),
      responder_butyrate = as.factor(responder_butyrate),
      carbohydrate = as.factor(carbohydrate)
    )
  rownames(maaslin2_butyrate_resp_meta) <- sample_names(ps_butyrate_resp_genus)
  
  maaslin2_butyrate_resp_fit <- tryCatch({
    suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
      capture.output(
        maaslin2_butyrate_resp_result <- Maaslin2::Maaslin2(
          input_data = maaslin2_butyrate_resp_counts,
          input_metadata = maaslin2_butyrate_resp_meta,
          output = tempfile(pattern = "maaslin2_butyrate_resp_", tmpdir = getwd()),
          min_prevalence = 0.05,
          normalization = "TSS",
          transform = "LOG",
          analysis_method = "LM",
          fixed_effects = c("responder_butyrate", "carbohydrate"),
          random_effects = c("subject_id"),
          plot_heatmap = FALSE,
          plot_scatter = FALSE
        ),
        file = nullfile()
      )
    ))
    maaslin2_butyrate_resp_result
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("MaAsLin2 butyrate responder failed:", e$message, "\n")
    NULL
  })
  
  # Extract MaAsLin2 results
  if (!is.null(maaslin2_butyrate_resp_fit) && !is.null(maaslin2_butyrate_resp_fit$results)) {
    maaslin2_butyrate_resp_tbl <- maaslin2_butyrate_resp_fit$results %>%
      dplyr::as_tibble() %>%
      dplyr::mutate(q = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH")) %>%
      dplyr::filter(metadata == "responder_butyrate") %>%
      dplyr::arrange(q)
    
    cat("MaAsLin2 butyrate responder:", 
        sum(maaslin2_butyrate_resp_tbl$q < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),
        "significant associations (q < 0.1)\n")
  } else {
    maaslin2_butyrate_resp_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
      feature = character(0),
      metadata = character(0),
      value = character(0),
      coef = numeric(0),
      pval = numeric(0),
      q = numeric(0)
    )
  }
} else {
  maaslin2_butyrate_resp_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
    feature = character(0),
    metadata = character(0),
    value = character(0),
    coef = numeric(0),
    pval = numeric(0),
    q = numeric(0)
  )
  cat("Insufficient samples for MaAsLin2 butyrate responder analysis\n")
}
```

### 7.6.2 ANCOM-BC2 and MaAsLin2 Visualizations: Butyrate Responders vs Non-Responders

```{r butyrate-responder-da-visualizations, echo=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
# ANCOM-BC2 Forest Plot
if (exists("ancombc2_butyrate_resp_tbl") && nrow(ancombc2_butyrate_resp_tbl) > 0) {
  forest_butyrate_resp_data <- ancombc2_butyrate_resp_tbl %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      ci_lower = beta - 1.96 * se,
      ci_upper = beta + 1.96 * se,
      taxon_label = stringr::str_replace(taxon, "^g__", ""),
      significance = dplyr::case_when(
        q_value < 0.001 ~ "q < 0.001",
        q_value < 0.01 ~ "q < 0.01",
        q_value < 0.05 ~ "q < 0.05",
        q_value < 0.1 ~ "q < 0.1",
        TRUE ~ "q ≥ 0.1"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(beta)))
  
  # Show top 25 taxa by effect size or all significant ones
  if (sum(forest_butyrate_resp_data$q_value < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
    forest_butyrate_resp_plot_data <- forest_butyrate_resp_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(q_value < 0.1) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(beta))) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 25)
  } else {
    forest_butyrate_resp_plot_data <- forest_butyrate_resp_data %>%
      dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(beta))) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 25)
  }
  
  if (nrow(forest_butyrate_resp_plot_data) > 0) {
    ancombc2_butyrate_resp_forest <- ggplot(
      forest_butyrate_resp_plot_data,
      aes(x = beta, y = reorder(taxon_label, beta), color = significance)
    ) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
      geom_point(size = 2) +
      geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_lower, xmax = ci_upper), 
                     height = 0.2, alpha = 0.8) +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c("q < 0.001" = "#d73027", 
                   "q < 0.01" = "#f46d43",
                   "q < 0.05" = "#fdae61", 
                   "q < 0.1" = "#fee08b",
                   "q ≥ 0.1" = "gray70"),
        name = "FDR-adjusted\np-value"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "ANCOM-BC2: Butyrate Responders vs Non-Responders",
        subtitle = "Effect sizes (log-fold change: Responder vs Non-Responder) with 95% confidence intervals",
        x = "Log-fold change (β)",
        y = "Genus",
        caption = "Positive values indicate higher abundance in Responders"
      ) +
      theme_scfa() +
      theme(
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.position = "bottom"
      )
    
    print(ancombc2_butyrate_resp_forest)
  } else {
    cat("No data available for ANCOM-BC2 butyrate responder forest plot\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No ANCOM-BC2 butyrate responder results available for visualization\n")
}

# MaAsLin2 Volcano Plot
if (exists("maaslin2_butyrate_resp_tbl") && nrow(maaslin2_butyrate_resp_tbl) > 0) {
  # Get taxonomy for labels
  tax_table_butyrate_resp <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_butyrate_resp_genus)) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("feature") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Genus_clean = stringr::str_replace(Genus, "^g__", ""),

      genus_label = dplyr::case_when(

        !is.na(Family_clean) & Family_clean != "NA" & Family_clean != "" ~ Family_clean,
        TRUE ~ feature
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(feature, genus_label)
  
  maaslin2_butyrate_resp_plot_data <- maaslin2_butyrate_resp_tbl %>%

  maaslin2_butyrate_resp_volcano <- ggplot(

      x = "Coefficient (Effect Size: Responder vs Non-Responder)",
      y = "-log10(q-value)",
      caption = "Red dashed line: q = 0.1 threshold; Positive values indicate higher abundance in Responders"
    ) +
    theme_scfa() +

  print(maaslin2_butyrate_resp_volcano)
} else {

}
```
